note: Runtime asset IDs whose game code depends on specific named animation clips existing on the rig. Required clip names are cross-checked against packages/assets/src/registry.json's referenced GLB file by validate-models.mjs. A missing required clip fails validation before it can fail at runtime.
sourceOfTruth: apps/game/src/world/GameWorld.tsx string-literal clip references, confirmed present in both rigs by the 2026-08-04 Gate 2 audit (docs/audits/2026-08-04-existing-asset-provenance/ASSET_PROVENANCE_AUDIT.md).
